topic: Reviewing and finalizing analytics staging environment
summary_markdown: The discussion covered the naming convention for key metrics, specifically whether to use 'Total screen traffic' or 'Total Traffic Screens,' and if 'traffic' and 'footfall' should be differentiated. Later, the focus shifted to reviewing the staging analytics environment (staging-analytics.allunite.com). The team confirmed that the data on the staging site was current and comparable to production data from two days prior. Several times, participants reviewed the results and planned for a discussion of the findings. A decision was made regarding updating the 'dataset version' label to STAGE before the final release.
decisions: The team agreed on a wording discussion for metrics like traffic vs. footfall at a later time.
The staging analytics environment was reviewed and deemed ready for release.
The 'dataset version' label must be changed to STAGE.
action_items: Release the new version of the analytics tool to production within approximately two hours.
